description: DB foundation: the 8 Transport Prisma models + 8 enums in schema.prisma, and the hand-authored lettered a-j migration 20270110000000_phase9_transport/migration.sql (indexes + 2 partial uniques, tenant-root + composite same-tenant FKs, CHECKs, ENABLE+FORCE RLS fail-closed pair on all 8, 3 column-guard triggers, campass_app GRANT refresh without DELETE, and the catalogue seed: TRANSPORT_MANAGER role FIRST, then 8 permissions, then 15 role_permission pairs). Prerequisite for everything else.
steps: In packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma add the 8 enums (design §B.2): TransportVehicleType {BUS,VAN,CAR,OTHER}, TransportVehicleStatus {ACTIVE,INACTIVE,MAINTENANCE}, TransportDriverStatus {ACTIVE,INACTIVE}, TransportRouteStatus {ACTIVE,INACTIVE}, TransportAssignmentStatus {ACTIVE,ENDED}, TransportEnrollmentStatus {ACTIVE,SUSPENDED,ENDED}, TransportMaintenanceStatus {OPEN,IN_PROGRESS,RESOLVED,CANCELLED}, TransportDayOfWeek {MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN}.

Add the 8 models with field shapes per design §B.1, each @@map('transport_*'), each with `institution Institution @relation(fields: [institutionId], references: [id])`, `@@unique([id, institutionId])`, `@@index([institutionId])` plus per-query indexes: TransportVehicle (registrationNo, type, seatCapacity Int, status default ACTIVE, createdByUserId, createdAt, updatedAt); TransportDriver (name, licenseNo, phone?, userId?, status default ACTIVE, createdByUserId, timestamps); TransportRoute (name, code, status default ACTIVE, feeAmount Int?, createdByUserId, timestamps); TransportRouteStop (routeId, name, sequence Int, landmark?, latitude Float?, longitude Float?, pickupOffsetMinutes Int?, createdByUserId, timestamps, index (institutionId,routeId)); TransportRouteAssignment (routeId, vehicleId, driverId, effectiveFrom, effectiveTo?, status default ACTIVE, createdByUserId, timestamps, indexes (institutionId,routeId)/(institutionId,vehicleId)); TransportEnrollment (studentId, routeId, stopId, status default ACTIVE, enrolledAt, endedAt?, createdByUserId, timestamps, indexes (institutionId,routeId)/(institutionId,studentId)); TransportVehicleMaintenanceRequest (vehicleId, issue, status default OPEN, assigneeUserId?, cost Int?, reportedByUserId, resolutionNote?, resolvedAt?, createdAt, updatedAt — NOTE: deliberately NO createdByUserId, reportedByUserId is the creator actor, mirroring hostel_maintenance_requests; index (institutionId,vehicleId)/(institutionId,status)); TransportRouteSchedule (routeId, stopId?, dayOfWeek TransportDayOfWeek?, date DateTime?, departureTime Int, arrivalTime Int?, createdByUserId, timestamps, index (institutionId,routeId)). All actor ids are plain String/String? with NO relation. Comment on each model that composite FKs/RLS/CHECKs/triggers are raw SQL (the hostel precedent at schema.prisma ~lines 3382-3480).

Add the 8 relation list fields to `model Institution` (near line 328-335, beside hostelBuildings etc.): transportVehicles, transportDrivers, transportRoutes, transportRouteStops, transportRouteAssignments, transportEnrollments, transportVehicleMaintenanceRequests, transportRouteSchedules. Add `transportEnrollments TransportEnrollment[]` to `model StudentProfile` (near line 535, beside hostelRoomAllocations).
Run `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db` to validate the schema and regenerate the Prisma client. Do NOT run prisma migrate dev.

Hand-author packages/db/prisma/migrations/20270110000000_phase9_transport/migration.sql mirroring 20270103000000_phase9_hostel/migration.sql section-for-section. (a) CREATE TYPE the 8 enums. (b) CREATE TABLE the 8 tables + PKs; mutable tables carry updatedAt TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL; there is NO createdAt-only (append-only) table this phase. (c) (id,institutionId) unique + (institutionId)/per-query indexes + business uniques (institutionId,registrationNo)/(institutionId,licenseNo)/(institutionId,code)/(institutionId,routeId,sequence) + the 2 partial uniques: transport_route_assignments_one_active_per_route ON (institutionId,routeId) WHERE status='ACTIVE', transport_enrollments_one_active_per_student_route ON (institutionId,studentId,routeId) WHERE status='ACTIVE'. (d) tenant-root FK institutionId->institutions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE on all 8. (e) composite same-tenant FKs per §E.e (stops/assignments/enrollments/maintenance/schedules -> their parents; enrollment -> student_profiles; schedule->stop uses default MATCH SIMPLE so a NULL stopId is a no-op, no CHECK). (f) CHECKs per §E.f: seatCapacity>=1, sequence>=1, pickupOffsetMinutes>=0, feeAmount>=0, cost>=0, non-empty name/registrationNo/licenseNo/code/issue via char_length>=1, schedule exactly-one-of dayOfWeek/date `((dayOfWeek IS NOT NULL)::int + (date IS NOT NULL)::int)=1`, departureTime/arrivalTime 0..1439, assignment effectiveTo IS NULL OR effectiveTo>=effectiveFrom.

Migration (g) RLS: ENABLE + FORCE on all 8 and apply the standard nullif-guarded {tenant_isolation_select, tenant_isolation_modify} pair via a DO $$ FOREACH $$ block using ONLY a mutable_tables array of all 8 (NO append_only_tables array this phase). (h) 3 column-guard functions + BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers mirroring hostel_room_allocations_guard/hostel_maintenance_requests_guard: transport_route_assignments_guard (frozen: institutionId,routeId,vehicleId,driverId,effectiveFrom,createdByUserId,createdAt; legal ACTIVE->ENDED + self), transport_enrollments_guard (frozen: institutionId,studentId,routeId,stopId,enrolledAt,createdByUserId,createdAt; legal ACTIVE->SUSPENDED, ACTIVE->ENDED, SUSPENDED->ENDED + self), transport_vehicle_maintenance_requests_guard (frozen: institutionId,vehicleId,reportedByUserId,createdAt; legal OPEN->IN_PROGRESS, IN_PROGRESS->RESOLVED, OPEN->CANCELLED, IN_PROGRESS->CANCELLED + self). Each raises `restrict_violation` on DELETE and on an illegal transition with a message containing the literal `illegal <table> status transition`. (i) guarded `IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='campass_app')` GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE on all 8 (NO DELETE, no REVOKE needed — no append-only table); never BYPASSRLS.

Migration (j) catalogue seed mirroring hostel's j EXACTLY: INSERT the role row ('role_transport_manager','TRANSPORT_MANAGER','Transport Manager',NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING FIRST (before the permissions block, so its ,NULL) tuple is outside the sliced permission span the catalogue-sync parser reads); then INSERT INTO permissions the 8 transport.* rows (module 'transport') ON CONFLICT ("key") DO NOTHING; then INSERT INTO role_permissions the 15 pairs via SELECT ... FROM (VALUES (role,perm)...) AS m("roleKey","permKey") JOIN roles r ON r.key=m.roleKey AND r.institutionId IS NULL JOIN permissions p ON p.key=m.permKey ON CONFLICT ("roleId","permissionId") DO NOTHING. The 15 pairs: ADMIN x {vehicles.manage, drivers.manage, routes.manage, assignments.manage, enrollments.manage, maintenance.manage, view}; TRANSPORT_MANAGER x the same 7; STUDENT x transport.view_own.

From packages/db: confirm the applied count with `npx prisma migrate status`, then `npx prisma migrate deploy`, then `npx prisma migrate status` again (all applied/up-to-date), then `npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma` and confirm only the known composite-vs-single-FK cosmetic diff and NO DROP on any existing table.
Commit locally on main (do not push). Record in findings the exact 8 permission keys and 15 role_permission pairs seeded, so FEAT-002 transcribes an identical set into @campusgate/shared.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run db:generate -w @campusgate/db` succeeds (schema valid, client regenerated).
`npx prisma migrate deploy` applies 20270110000000_phase9_transport and `npx prisma migrate status` reports all migrations applied and up to date.
`npx prisma migrate diff` shows only the known composite-FK cosmetic diff and NO DROP on any existing table.

All 8 transport_* tables exist with institutionId, (id,institutionId) unique, (institutionId) index, composite same-tenant FKs, and ENABLE+FORCE RLS; the 2 partial uniques and 3 column-guard triggers exist; campass_app has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE (no DELETE) on all 8 and is NOT BYPASSRLS.
No prior migration directory is modified (all stay byte-identical) and _prisma_migrations is untouched.

cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma migrate status
cd packages/db && npx prisma migrate diff --from-schema-datasource prisma/schema.prisma --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma
